text: maya: Quick heads up — draft of the product announcement is in this doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleDocID. Please review by Thu EOD. I'm specifically asking for: benchmark numbers verification, legal language check on 'up to 5x faster', webinar CTA text, and inbound lead routing (UTMs + HubSpot field). Thanks! sam: I can handle the benchmark numbers. Can you drop the dataset and test config you used? maya: Linked at the bottom of the doc under "benchmarks". It's internal perf/2026-03/gpt-like. TL;DR: 3-5x token throughput vs baseline on our dedicated config. We need to decide whether to say "up to 5x" or "~3-5x". leo: Recommend "up to 5x" only if we add a clear footnote with hardware+seq length. Otherwise legal will push back. claire-legal: I'll review. Please add the footnote: hardware (A100 80GB), seq len 1024, measured on ded-8x. Also avoid absolute claims like "guaranteed". priya: For webinar CTA — propose: "Join our launch webinar — live demo + model tuning tips". Also suggest we add a button for "Request Dedicated Trial" for enterprise. marco-sales: +1 on the trial CTA. Also need lead routing: add tag "launch_2026" and route to AE queue #3. Can we standardize UTMs? ben: Here's a suggested UTM snippet we can append to the webinar and blog CTAs: ``` ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=product_launch_2026 ``` maya: Perfect. Marco — can you confirm HubSpot form mapping? We need to set "interest" field -> "Dedicated Trial / Webinar" and add owner assignment rule. marco-sales: Yep, I'll create a workflow: if form contains "Request Dedicated Trial" -> tag owner=AE_team_3, pipeline=dedicated_inbound. ETA tomorrow morning. claire-legal: Quick note — the customer quote used in the draft needs explicit consent for the full name. Is the one in the doc cleared? maya: Quote is anonymized but uses company descriptor. I'll confirm and swap if needed. sam: On the benchmarks — sending short summary of test harness and metrics in DM. For the post, I'd prefer phrasing: "we observed up to 5x token throughput in our dedicated configuration (A100, seq=1024); results vary by model and workload." keeps it accurate. leo: That phrasing looks good to me. claire-legal: Approved with footnote and consent check. I'll put comments on the doc. priya: I'll update the CTA copy and add webinar signup embed code. Quick HTML snippet for marketing: ``` Register for the webinar ``` maya: Great. Plan: finalize copy today, legal approval in doc, sam + leo sign off on benchmarks, marco to set routing. Target publish Fri 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping here. ben: I'll set the tracking dashboard and pre-create the UTM filters in GA. marco-sales: Workflow created draft; will test with a staging form and report back. maya: Thank you all — will post final doc here once edits are in. :rocket:
